title: UI link: a client without the token can hold the only link session for 5 minutes

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found in a security review of PR #3861 (part 1 of #3751).

**What happens**

The UI link serves one client at a time. The token check is on the first line, but the same deadlines apply before and after the token check:

- `crates/app/src/mcp/listen.rs:181`: the link uses `IDLE_TIMEOUT` (5 minutes) for its listener.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/listen.rs:233-255`: `accept_loop` serves clients one after the other.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/listen.rs:283-351`: before the hello line, the read loop accepts up to `MAX_LINE` (16 MiB, line 56) and waits up to the idle window.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/listen.rs:330-334`: the token check occurs only when a complete line arrives.

On Windows the link is TCP on 127.0.0.1 (`crates/app/src/mcp/link.rs:221-226`). Each local user can connect to that port. A client without the token can connect and send no newline. It then holds the only session for 5 minutes. It can connect again after the drop. During that time, `camcraft-cli --ui` cannot reach the window. The app also buffers up to 16 MiB for an unauthenticated client.

No command runs, and the UI thread does not stop. This is a denial of service of the link only.

**Expected**

A client that does not send a valid hello line in a short time (for example 5 s) is closed. The hello line has a small size limit (for example 4 KiB). The 5-minute idle window and the 16 MiB limit apply only after the token check.

**Done means**

- A pre-hello deadline and a pre-hello size limit exist in `listen.rs`.
- A test in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs` connects, sends no hello, and shows that a second client with the token gets a session after the short deadline.

Refs #3751, PR #3861.
